cancellation_rebooking_rule.name: Cancellation Rebooking Rule
cancellation_rebooking_rule.description: If a flight is cancelled by the airline, the customer is entitled to a free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours, OR a full refund. Customer chooses.
options: Free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours

delay_compensation_rule.name: Delay Compensation Rule
delay_compensation_rule.description: Compensation for airline-caused delays scales with delay duration.
delay_compensation_rule.hotel_note: Hotel accommodation covers ONLY the delayed hours. It does NOT automatically mean a full night's stay.

refund_rule.name: Refund Processing Rule
refund_rule.description: For airline-caused cancellations, a full refund is processed within 7 business days to the original payment method only. Refunds to a different payment method are not permitted without escalation.

fare_difference_rule.name: Fare Difference Rule
fare_difference_rule.description: If a customer voluntarily chooses a higher-fare flight (not airline-caused), the customer pays the fare difference. Agents cannot waive fare differences above the authority threshold without supervisor approval.

loyalty_tier_rule.name: Loyalty Tier Rule
loyalty_tier_rule.description: Gold and Platinum tier customers receive priority rebooking (first access to next-available seats). This does NOT provide additional compensation beyond standard policy.

escalation_triggers.name: Mandatory Escalation Conditions
conditions: Fare difference waiver requested above agent authority threshold
Exception requested for a non-airline-caused disruption
Customer states intent to file a formal complaint
Refund requested to a different payment method
Any request requiring authority not present in supplied policy (e.g. upgrades)
